## Description

During or after transcription, phrases indicating possible emergencies (configurable list reviewed by the clinical advisor, multilingual) raise "Possible emergency mentioned at 02:41: '…'. This is a prompt, not triage. You decide; acknowledgement is logged." Actions: Acknowledge / Not relevant (reason).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The prompt never changes orders, notes or patient messages automatically.
- [ ] **AC2.** Acknowledge/Not relevant are recorded with actor, time and reason.
- [ ] **AC3.** The phrase list is versioned and clinically reviewed; detection is tested in en/hi/ta.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
